Based on the visual analysis of the screenshot, here are the exact colors for the specified areas:

1.  **Top header bar:** **White** (or very light off-white/cream, approximately **#F9F7F2** or **#FFFFFF**).
2.  **Hero section background:** **Cream** / Light Beige (a very light warm gray, approximately **#F5F1E8** or **#FAF8F3**).
3.  **Large hero title text:** **Dark Green** (specifically a deep forest green, approximately **#1A4D3E** or **#16423C**).
4.  **'دخول' (Login) button:** Yes, it is visible in the top right corner of the header. The text is **Dark Green** (matching the title), and the background is transparent (it appears to be a text-only link or outline button).
5.  **Footer background:** **Dark Green** (the same deep green as the title text, approximately **#1A4D3E**).
6.  **CTA section ('شارك في المجلة'):** There is no distinct colored CTA section with that specific text visible in this screenshot. The area asking "هل لديك فكرة تستحق أن تُنشر؟" uses the same **Cream/Light Beige** background as the rest of the page body.
